title: Use it for a known amount of work

do.text: Use a progress bar when you know how much is left: files, steps, bytes.

dont.text: Don't spin a spinner for work you can measure: show how far along it is.

title: Match the colour to the outcome

do.text: Fill a finished bar in the success colour.

dont.text: Don't fill a finished, successful bar in the destructive colour.
